images.name: TransMontaigne Partners LLC
images.subsector: Bulk liquid storage, terminaling and transportation
images.description: TransMontaigne Partners LLC is a Denver-based U.S. midstream infrastructure platform providing terminaling, storage, transportation, blending and related logistics for refined petroleum products, renewable fuels and feedstocks, crude oil, chemicals, fertilizers and other bulk liquids. Its network spans 54 terminal facilities across major U.S. markets. ArcLight acquired platform control through the general partner in February 2016, and ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI completed the take-private in February 2019. TLP Finance Holdings now owns 100% of TransMontaigne and is an indirect wholly owned Fund VI subsidiary. Pike Holdings and Pike Petroleum Holdings are upstream sponsor-shell census labels, not separate PortCos; intermediate holding vehicles, operating subsidiaries and individual assets beneath TransMontaigne are subsumed. No platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

ownershipPeriods.stake: 100% of TransMontaigne Partners LLC at the operating-platform level; ArcLight acquired control in 2016 and full platform ownership followed the 2019 take-private; current Pike Petroleum Holdings shell capitalization is not publicly disclosed

milestones.event: An ArcLight affiliate completed its $350 million acquisition of TransMontaigne GP and obtained control of the platform; NGL retained public units and its separate marketing business.
TransMontaigne announced a definitive agreement for an indirect ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI subsidiary to acquire the remaining public units for approximately $536 million.
Fund VI's take-private closed, making TransMontaigne wholly owned; the platform converted from TransMontaigne Partners L.P. to TransMontaigne Partners LLC and TLP Finance became sole managing member.
